marker: This is a real macOS release build of the same repository commit. It is NOT Mac<->Windows peer-pair evidence and makes no claim about physical Windows hardware.
meaning: The migrated loopback-TCP graft post-send transport (no interprocess::local_socket on any platform) compiles and links into the release atm binary on physical macOS. Physical peer-pair execution across a macOS and a Windows host remains open (AI10-WINDOWS-001, AI14-QA1-EVIDENCE-GAP).
